name: Hansson & Karlsson
bio: Hansson & Karlsson was a swedish duo consisting of Bo Hansson (organ) and Janne "Loffe" Carlsson (drums). The duo was active during the end of the 1960s and played instrumental jazz rock and psychedelic music. The music was much built around improvisations, and because of that their live shows varied much from show to show. The group could be said to be an early inspiration to Swedish progg rock. They met Jimi Hendrix and played with him a couple of times.
